notes.title: Patch 1.05 + New Project Update
notes.content:
- Removed dialogue referring to a "map vendor" that doesn't exist
- All enemies now take increased elemental damage
- Various bugs with the camera have been fixed
- Fixed an issue where enemies where clipping out of bounds
- "Cut to Ribbons" skill for the "Ninjato" now has a proper TP cost
- Various typos have been fixed
- Tons more bugs not specifically listed have been fixed over the past year (if any pop up please list them in the discussions page)

I have been very busy working on the next game in this series, it's a prequel to The Scarlet Chaos.
I plan to reveal it with the Steam page when I feel it is ready, the page should be ready by the end of the year or sooner :)  if you're a fan of survival horror it may pique your interest.

notes.title: Thank you to supporters! + Patch 1.04
notes.content:
It's already been one month since launch! Thanks to all that supported the game during it's first month, I hope it's been an enjoyable game for you all!

Today Patch 1.04 has also been released, fixing some clipping errors and progression bugs.

- A bug that prevented progress in "All Hallow's Eve" has been fixed
- An infinite XP bug in South Marsh has also been fixed
- Many clipping errors have been squashed

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
-Fixed many chests that were infinitely lootable
-Removed dialouge with Willem that was meant to be cut
-Fixed an issue that let players skip to the final act
-Fixed an issue that made the player temporarily invisble after chapter V
-The Kawodinage Band now properly increases healing when equipped
-Legacy of Kaletaw quest will now propely give the completion achievement no matter what ending,
interacting with the Spear chest again will also give the achievement for those who were affected
by this bug.
-Fixed an issue where Ayahuasca wasn't properly giving Cognition EXP
-The Gilded Blunderbuss in now two-handed as intended

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
- Fixed some small terrain issues
- Fixed an issue that was giving the "From Below" achievement too early
- Fixed a chest in Crossroads from being looted repeatedly
- Fixed a bug that allowed a party member to speak in dialogue that wasn't in the party yet

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue that let players keep interacting with the drawer in the Valdrew guest home
- Moved the fast-travel at the Fortress to travel you just outside of Valdrew to prevent a sequence break
- Fixed various out of bounds clipping bugs
- Tons of miscellaneous bugs have been squashed
- Certain merchants now sell more items
- Enemies now drop more items

I apologize for the amount of bugs that made it into the final release, this was something I was fearful of as a solo developer, it's quite hard to find them all, but I'll patch any all that I find. Please report any that you encounter on the discussions page.

- DayDreamer

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content:
- Fixed various out of bounds bugs around Valdrew and other areas
- Improved "Round em up" quest, the code has been rewritten, this fix may only work with new save files, sorry if that's the case :(
- Armor has been adjusted
- Elemental weakness damage has been adjusted for enemies
- Fixed a bug that was causing the night filter to not show up outside
- Typos and other grammar issues have been fixed
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This patch will also reset the options including controls - I'm going to look for a way around this in the future, but I'm not certain anything can be done.
